_metadata.description: OT-P2-002 — readiness answerable via search. Satisfied by cli-health command federation; dedicated attested-answer provider descoped.

requirements.title: readiness answers discoverable via search-hub (cli-health command federation)
requirements.description: The user need — 'how ready are we / where should I work' answerable through search — is already satisfied by cli-health's command federation: a federated search-hub query surfaces meta-optimization-manager's coverage/focus commands (e.g. `status`, `validate-docs`, `list-cells`) with their descriptions, routing the agent to the right command. A dedicated MoM search provider that emits the AttestedAnswer envelope (confidence + citations inline in the search result) is DESCOPED as redundant for this need — see docs/internal/DECISIONS.md (2026-06-24). The additive `AttestedAnswer` carrier on search-hub `SearchHit` stays available for any future provider that wants inline attestation, but MoM does not self-register one.

validation.notes: Previously verified live, but current revalidation returns a provider HTTP 500 while the shared vector substrate is stopped/degraded; re-attest after healthy-substrate restoration.

requirements.title: agent work history appears in the Answer projection with honest condition evidence
requirements.description: Answer cell 37 maps the prior-work question to agent-manager.runs. Meta Optimization Manager reuses Search Hub registry, reachability, index degradation, and tiered eval evidence; it does not create a second registry, a dedicated conversation provider, or a Meta Optimization search endpoint.
